name: Double Gate
tagline: Soldiers fortify a construction site with two gates - unaware the radio they salvaged is a beacon for the dead.
summary: Double Gate is the second Zombie Scenario map. Soldiers escaping the zombie-infested city centre spot two mysteriously equipped individuals fleeing a construction site, pick up the radio equipment they left behind and fortify a defensive position with construction materials. Players hold two reinforceable gates against waves of zombies arriving from three directions over 5 rounds.
story: According to the wiki, soldiers escaping the zombie-infested city centre discovered two mysteriously equipped individuals fleeing a construction site. After acquiring the radio equipment the strangers left behind, the soldiers fortified a defensive position using construction materials to prepare for the zombie attack. A second account on the page describes an advance unit finding suspicious individuals in a village who flee, leaving their gear behind; the unit takes the radio equipment, unaware that it has attracted the zombies.
objectives: Survive the attacks from waves of incoming zombies arriving from three different locations.
5 rounds with a 3-minute time limit per round.
Reinforce the gates: $5,000 per level, up to a maximum of 28 levels.
characters: Two unidentified individuals (later revealed to be connected to Dr. Rex)
rewards: Honor mission [Gate Keeper]: clear Double Gate 400 times
trivia: The 26 March 2015 South Korea update reduced the round count from 20 to 5 and raised the honor requirement from 100 to 400 clears; the medal graphics and Steam achievement were not updated to reflect the change.
